paper_title: A quantum-enhanced search for dark matter axions
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted from gamma = 1.38 x g_gamma^KSVZ using KSVZ g_gamma=-0.97 and m_a f_a relation)
notes: HAYSTAC quantum-enhanced (squeezed state receiver) axion haloscope. Exclusion reported as g_gamma >= 1.38 x g_gamma^KSVZ over combined 16.96-17.12 and 17.14-17.28 ueV/c2 (4.100-4.140 & 4.145-4.178 GHz). Paper only gives coupling relative to KSVZ; I converted to g_agamma using KSVZ g_gamma=-0.97, alpha, and m_a[ueV]=5.70(1e12 GeV/f_a), giving g_KSVZ~6.7e-15 GeV^-1 and 1.38x ~9.3e-15 GeV^-1 across the narrow window.
